routes.reason: WHOLE_PROTEIN is limited to FUNCTION, EVOLUTION, SEQ_FAMILY and SEQ_HOMOLOGOUS_SUPERFAMILY. Generic binding or functional membership cannot provide structural-site coordinates.

routes.status: no generic producer in current resolver
routes.reason: Schema enum presence is not producer support. Dispatch implements INTERPRO_MATCH, exact UniProt fact methods, and SIFTS_RESIDUE_MAPPING; other methods receive unsupported:mapping_method. SOURCE_DATABASE also fails closed without an exact source-specific contract and acquisition receipt.

Only ECOD and BioLiP mapping-registry families are loaded. Generic PDB/publication motif rows are not supported. Validator preserves receipt-required locks for SIFTS, ECOD, SCOPe, CATH, 3did, BioLiP, M-CSA, MetalPDB and RepeatsDB.

routes.status: schema-supported distinct representation; not canonical qualification
routes.reason: Both representation classes accept structure_ref and evidence_source; geometry also accepts source and residue_range. A source-inspected representative can be selected through the guarded editor with honest chain/construct/version provenance, while unknown bounds remain absent. It cannot establish a QUALIFIED CanonicalExample or satisfy residue-mapping requirements. No dedicated chain/frame/version fields exist in these representation classes; source provenance must retain that context. Legacy enrich_structural_provenance.py illustrates representation semantics and is listed in audit_writers.py, but uses direct path.write_text. Its old bypass is not the validated, behaviorally tested route required by this launch brief for new edits; it was not invoked.

prerequisites_for_qualified_generic_stru: Coordinate with the current owners of grounding/qualification code before any implementation; root is refreshing remote PR state.
A source-specific, receipt-bound producer must select exact asserted motif/site residues and exact PDB revision/chain/construct; do not synthesize a generic source row by hand.

A supported source contract must replay complete residue-level SIFTS mapping against a release-matched UniProt ProteinReference, including insertion codes, missing residues, amino-acid identities and all trait-defining positions.
Candidate generation and source-aware content validation must assert the exact internal trait identity without equating domains, folds, motifs, geometry and function.
Persist immutable resolved rows/resolution digests, source-stratified scientific review and explicit decision ledgers before any separately authorized promotion.
Promotion must install matching evidence/bindings and pass require-qualified semantic validation, guarded-writer and registry-integrity gates.
limitations: This dossier is discovery/route evidence, not a native completed scientific review bundle.
No fresh UniProt fetch receipt or SIFTS acquisition manifest was obtained.
Source-native PDB/raw header and PDBsum requests through the web tool failed; no exact coordinate assignment was invented.
Current local code at the pinned base is inspected; root owns remote overlap verification.
